name: Coppélia
bio: Archetype: Conduit, Mineral Energy. ⌽ Does not obtain normal incantations, rather charges [Conduit]s with [Energy] to release incantations, Moxie is replaced with Harmonization. ⌽ When entering battle, increases all allies' Conduit might and increase self Harmonization. ⌽ Every time an ally triggers an [Conduit], gains 1 stack of [Scale Steps], which increases Ult might. ⌽ S1 is standard with DMG increasing based on [Conduit Energy Consumption] and S2 buff both Crit stats. ⌽ Ult consumes all [Interval Step] to increase the level of [Conduit Energy Consumption] and gives 3 stacks of [Conduit Tuning I] to self and the ally directly behind, then flux to S1.
